item.title: LevinDB
item.description: Concurrent in-memory Key-Value store in Go designed with a 64-way sharded mutex architecture, custom TCP binary protocol, and Write-Ahead Log (WAL) for durability.

item.title: GSOC 2025 Submission for GRAME: faustlsp
item.description: Language Server Protocol (LSP) implementation for Faust audio DSP language with Tree-Sitter AST parsing in Go, plus a VS Code extension with Topiary Rust formatting.

item.title: GRAME - Centre National de Création Musicale
item.description: Developed faustlsp (Go, Tree-Sitter) and a VS Code extension (TypeScript, Rust) for Faust DSP language during Google Summer of Code with GRAME in Lyon, France.

item.title: Wizard Quest
item.description: A Pokémon-GO inspired Augmented Reality and Computer Vision web platform that gamifies real-world exploration events, backed by FastAPI & Postgres.

item.title: Knack Peer Tutoring
